why: I checked every command in both briefs and all of them would run as written. The builder's steps only touch files that exist (root package.json, package-lock.json, the test workflow, README.md, CLAUDE.md) or that an earlier step creates (packages/jsonl-lint/*). `npm install`, `npm ci` and `npm test` are all valid. In the verifier brief, `node --input-type=module -e "import { lint } from './packages/...'; ... lint('{\"a\":1}\n{bad\n') ..."` quotes correctly in bash and is valid JS, and the relative import resolves from the repo root. `npm test -w jsonl-lint`, `gh pr view --json body,headRefOid,state`, `gh pr list --search 102 --state all`, `gh pr checks` and `gh run list --commit` all take those arguments. The command still works as long as the inputs are created where the command runs, so it isn't a broken command.
